tools.name: find_ai_companies
tools.description: Find AI companies that can solve a business problem and build a comparison shortlist. Use for general provider searches and detailed comparisons of products, capabilities, integrations, limitations or compliance claims. Examples: automate customer emails and website chats; answer calls and book appo

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Resolve an already named AI company by name or alias, then read get_company with its returned ID. The default company_name mode also accepts concise literal capability keywords for broader unranked candidates; such matches do not prove industry fit. tools.description: Checks a named or discovered AI vendor's products and evidence when evaluating a sales proposal, comparing alternatives or verifying product claims. tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: Lists supported industries with canonical IDs/slugs, names, descriptions and aliases. Includes cross-industry, consumer and agent audiences when available. An optional query filters this directory; without it the directory is browsable with pagination.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Lists AI solution task IDs, slugs, descriptions and company coverage, optionally within an industry. An optional query filters the directory. Ambiguous 'AI verification platform', 'verification' and 'verify' queries include clarification_required with identities/KYC, document authenticity and factua

tools.description: Compares AI software for a known industry/task using published positions, reasons, best use cases, evidence and caveats.
